name: Cyborg Engineer
body:
Though many may utilize the wide array of technological advancements that permeate society, few truly command them with the skill and understanding of a cyborg engineer. By harnessing his innate abilities to augment the devices and materials around him, cyborg engineers demonstrate a mastery of all machines.

Technological Investment

A cyborg engineer may use his own internal mechanisms to operate machines around him. The cyborg engineer may invest his essence into technological items that he possesses. The normal limitations for essence capacity apply, and this capacity is increased by the cyborg engineer’s improved essence capacity ability.

The cyborg engineer chooses how much essence to invest at the start of the day when he shapes his veils, and essence distributed to technological items in this way cannot be redistributed for 24 hours. For every point of essence distributed in a technological item, the item can be used once without consuming any charges.

This ability replaces eldritch insight.

Mechanical Attunement: In place of the vizier’s normal mystic attunements, a cyborg engineer may select the mechanical attunement, which grants the following abilities.

Mechanical Attunement

The cyborg engineer gains Technologist* as a bonus feat and may add 1/2 his class level (minimum 1) to all Craft and Knowledge (engineering) checks that he attempts. In addition, the cyborg engineer gains the following abilities: Fluid Energy: A cyborg engineer is capable of transferring energy between batteries with ease, transforming the shape and nature of energy with a thought. As a swift action, a cyborg engineer may transfer a number of charges equal to his class level between two technological devices within a 30-foot radius. These exchanged charges can be allocated however the cyborg engineer prefers.

Augment Technology

Whenever a creature within 30 feet of the cyborg engineer attacks with a technological weapon, the cyborg engineer may grant the weapon a +1 bonus to its save DC and a bonus equal to the cyborg engineer’s Intelligence modifier to its damage roll.

At 5th level, the cyborg engineer receives Craft Technological Item* as a bonus feat.

At 9th level, the cyborg engineer receives Craft Technological Arms and Armor* as a bonus feat.

At 13th level, the cyborg engineer receives Craft Cybernetics* as a bonus feat, even if he does not meet the prerequisites.

At 17th level, the cost of crafting all technological items is reduced by 25%.

Viziers and Psionic Items

At GM discretion, a vizier may use eldritch insight, technological investment, or similar abilities to invest essence into items that use power points (such as dorjes, psicrowns, and other items). When they do so, the ability reduces the number of power points used with each manifestation from the item by 1 for every point of essence invested in this ability (minimum 0).

Attunements
Path of the gestalt

A vizier who chooses this path has bonded their existence with a swarm of nano machines, so that as one they can accomplish feats that neither could alone. At 1st level the vizier gains Psicrystal Affinity as a bonus feat, even if he does not meet the prerequisites. He uses his class level as his manifester level to determine the power of his psicrystal. A psicrystal gained in this way always has the nanite swarm* archetype. If their psicrystal is destroyed, the gestalt can gain a new one after they shape their veils for the day.

Akashic Swarm (Su)

The vizier gains the ability to invest essence into his nanite swarm just like a veil or other akashic receptacle. For each point of essence invested in the nanite swarm, it gains a +1 insight bonus on saving throws and skill checks, and gains 5 additional hit points. If the nanite swarm takes enough damage to be destroyed, the gestalt regains any essence invested in it, but takes essence burn equal to the amount of essence regained.

Once he reaches 3rd level, the vizier can use his veilshifting ability to temporarily change the purpose ability possessed by his psicrystal as if reshaping a veil.

They can only use this ability to gain access to the gray goo and nano-material cloud purpose abilities. This change lasts for a number of rounds equal to the vizier’s Intelligence modifier and counts as a veil being reshaped for the purposes of the veilshifting ability.

Gestalt Talent

At 5th, 13th, and 17th level the vizier selects a gestalt talent from the list available to the hivemind*.

He must meet the prerequisites of any gestalt talent and has an effective hivemind level equal to his vizier level for the purpose of meeting prerequisites. If the vizier uses veilshifting to change his swarm’s purpose ability, he loses the benefits of any gestalt talents he no longer meets the prerequisites for.

Swarm Conduit

At 9th level, the vizier gains the ability to share one veil they have shaped with their nanite swarm. The veil must be shaped to one of the following slots and the nanite swarm is considered to have these slots for the purpose of this ability: Body, Head, Headband, or Ring. The nanite swarm gains the benefits of any essence the vizier has invested in the shared veil, but retains the veil and its benefits only if it is within 30 feet of the vizier.

The vizier may change which veil is shared in this way as standard action. If a shared veil grants a natural attack or produces a weapon, the nanite swarm cannot attack.

When the vizier’s nanite swarm gains the channel power ability, the range of this ability increases from 30 feet to 1 mile.
